title: Free Content and New Performance Cache!
raw:
[p][b]Update 8/‌25/‌2026
PC: 1.127.41.1030 / Mac: 1.127.41.1230
Console: 2.38
[/b][/p][p]Sul sul,[/p][p]With this update we are bringing improvements to your Marketplace browsing experience. Previously, Marketplace images were downloaded every time you browsed. Now, they’re cached after the first download, so we’ll only download images that are new or have changed.
[/p][p]Along with performance improvements, Create a Sim (CAS) is getting some stylish additions, including new clothing especially designed to celebrate Sims of every size, plus an out-of-this-world hairstyle.
[/p][p]And of course, we are bringing some important bug fixes with this update.[/p][p]-The Sims Team
[/p][h2][b]What’s New?
[/b][/h2][h3][b]Image Cache[/b][/h3][p]The new Image Cache looks to improve loading times and reduce downloading of images across the Marketplace on subsequent visits, reducing the time needed to do a little window shopping or picking up that new Maker Pack you see everyone talking about.[/p][p]If you run into any issues with Marketplace images, you can manually clear the image cache by opening the cheat console and running the cheat command:[/p][list][*][p]clearonlinethumbnailcache true[/p][/*][/list][p]While our PlayStation and XBOX Simmers can’t peek under the hood at the cache directly, on PC/Mac you can view this cache by navigating to: [/p][list][*][p]Documents\\Electronic Arts\\The Sims 4\\onlinethumbnailcache[/p][/*][/list][p]The cache will also be automatically maintained 14 days after the last Marketplace visit and remove unused images and free up space on your storage device, and while the cache has an upper limit of 250MB the space the cache uses will generally be lower. 
[/p][h3][b]New Size-Inclusive Styles[/b][/h3][p]This base game drop enhances body diversity representation in Create a Sim by adding a new set of CAS assets designed to flatter Sims of all shapes and sizes. [/p][p]This drop contains 6 new CAS assets—from a versatile dress, tops, jeans, cardigans, shirts, and slacks—along with 5 new Styled Looks that use these items to help jump-start your outfit inspiration. [/p][p]We’re also adding 5 new Starter Sims, each created to showcase these new outfits and clothing options. In addition to finding these Sims in CAS, they will also be available on the Gallery so you can easily bring them into your worlds and give them a story!
[/p][h3][b]New Afro-Textured Hair[/b][/h3][p]Hair is, and continues to be, a powerful part of self-expression, and we know how much it means to you all to see more styles and textures represented in the game.[/p][p]Our newest hair addition is an afro-textured hairstyle inspired by the art of natural hair sculpting... and it’s giving whimsical, cosmic beauty with plenty of main-character energy! We had so much fun developing this look that we couldn’t stop dreaming up different Sims to wear it. Now it’s your turn! We can’t wait to see how you style it.
